codename: The Holographic UI & Modular Sessions Update
title: Modular Sessions, Holographic UI & Window Logic
summary: This major update refactors the Chat Core into a modular architecture, introduces a persistent thread database, and deploys the 'Holographic Blade' sidebar interface with advanced native windowing logic.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Implemented the 'Holographic Blade' sidebar overlay using QListView and QStyledItemDelegate, featuring Dark Glass visuals, a Neon Cyan spine, and tactical Ruler Ticks.
Added a Focus Scrim dimming layer over the main chat that activates when the sidebar is open.
Introduced a Right-Click context menu with a '⚠️ TERMINATE THREAD' option for safe chat deletion.
Implemented the 'No Bleed' protocol: Switching chats forces the AI to immediately halt generation to prevent cross-thread text contamination.
Added nativeEvent logic for correct Windows Snap and Maximize behavior, including dynamic margins that remove glowing borders when maximized.
Introduced Inset Docking to allow the sidebar to adapt its geometry dynamically based on windowed versus maximized states.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Split the monolithic Visar_Chat_Core.py into a modular architecture, extracting sidebar logic to gui/sidebar/session_sidebar.py.
Migrated session management to a robust Thread System utilizing sessions_index.json (Database) and threads/chat_ID.json (Logs).
Reorganized data storage paths to data/Visar_Chat_Core/sessions/ for professional-grade state management.
Upgraded sidebar animation to a crash-proof, width-based transition (0px to 280px) to eliminate Windows OS transparency artifacts.
Optimized interaction logic with Smart Sorting, pushing recent chats to the top using a 'Dirty Check' to bypass unnecessary re-sorting.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Resolved 'Ghost Resurrection' where deleted files would reappear in the UI upon typing.
Fixed application crashes caused by manual file deletion, ensuring index errors are now handled gracefully.
Enforced strict clipping on sidebar items to completely eliminate horizontal overflow.
Fixed duplicate spawning by ensuring the loading of old chats correctly updates the session ID.
Applied automatic eliding to sidebar titles, appending '...' to prevent text overflow.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Removed legacy single-file overwrite logic in favor of the persistent multi-thread database.
Removed traditional UI grid lines in favor of the new sci-fi tactical 'Ruler Ticks'.

notes: Version 1.1.5.0 represents a foundational shift in how VISAR Edge handles user state. By moving to a multi-threaded JSON database and integrating native OS windowing rules, the UI is now fully crash-resistant and visually aligned with the Stark Tech ecosystem.
